summary.text: Ice path crystal essence is a rare rank eight ice path immortal material from the secluded domain Hu.

claims.text: Ice path crystal essence appears as a mountain-like blue crystal rock with crystallized texture and countless holes of varying sizes. Cold icy smoke spews from those holes without cease and changes the environment to a great extent. It is an extremely rare rank eight immortal material that originated from the secluded domain of heaven and earth Hu, and it is rarely seen in the market.
With one such essence, a snow monster production line can be established as a lasting source of revenue.

Three ice path crystal essences serve as cores of snow crystal formation, each large like a mountain peak, ice-blue, with holes that spew cold and icy air unceasingly. Frosty air from them carves ice and snow path dao marks into the surroundings for a while, modifying the environment into a habitat suited to snowmen and snow monsters.

The essences alone can produce snow monsters by existing; the formation mainly spreads and controls that frost energy over a wide range. They are expendable and will be used up eventually. The frost energy’s dao marks dissipate after a time and do not increase a sovereign immortal aperture’s total ice and snow path dao marks. A formation path great grandmaster could use the three essences’ natural dao marks directly and would not need ice path Immortal Gu as cores for that formation.

When Gu Immortals inspect a spherical underground cave packed with immortal materials and guess at Hu Land, they name earth path, water path, and lightning path crystal essences among the crystal essence stock. Water path and lightning path crystal essences from that list are covered on water path crystal essence and lightning path crystal essence. In the same cache, earth blood veins outnumber the crystal essence and lead to a black-yellow heart; those finds are covered on earth blood veins and black-yellow heart.

Origin.text: Secluded domain of heaven and earth, Hu
